author: Honkai: Star Rail
text:
"Aha Instant" | #AeonAha
"Akivili, who has set forth once more... can you guess who I am now? A comic artist? A Mourning Actor? A Nameless? The Lotto Goddess...? In this cosmic drama, Aha has worn countless Masks, but from beginning to end, I have been the master of every twist upon the stage. The stars are already singing for us. Ready to embark on a grand carnival of revelry together?"

Cries and comedy intertwine, and the deathly still cosmos awakens to daybreak in a farce.
Stepping back onto the stage of the Path, I tear off the god's mask. Who is Aha? I am Aha!
To play, to trick, to hunt... Please bear witness to an Improv Tour where humans and gods dance as one!

Aha! Proudly presenting the Aeon Aha as:
✧ "The Aeons' Strictest Mother" 1st Place ✧
✧ "Aha Bets on Underdogs and Wins Big" 1st Place ✧
✧ "Miss You So Much My Head Fell Off" 1st Place ✧
